SELECT trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as totle, trd.PS as dataType, trd.TRADE_DATE as trade, stl.SETTLE_DATE as settle, trd.PORTFOLIO_ID as porid, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME as pormame,
trd.PS as ordertype, stl.PAY_TYPE as pay, stl.SETTLE_AMT as amt, stl.CCY as ccy, stl.REMARK as remark,
CASE WHEN stl2.ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '已处理' WHEN stl2.ORDER_ID IS NULL THEN '未处理' END AS state,
Case WHEN stl.PS='01' then stl.MY_ACCT_NO WHEN stl.PS='02' then stl.COUNTER_ACCT_NO End as account ,
Case WHEN stl.PS='01' then stl.COUNTER_ACCT_NO WHEN stl.PS='02' then stl.MY_ACCT_NO End as trusteeship, trd.PS as ps
FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL trd Inner JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS stl ON trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = stl.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T5 ON trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T5.TOTLE_TRADE_ID Left JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ptl ON ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID = trd.PORTFOLIO_ID Left JOIN STL_ACT_TRADE_MATCH stl2 ON stl2.TRADE_ID = trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
WHERE trd.PS IN ('C6','C1','C2','C4','C9','C5','C20','C17','C3') AND stl.IS_NEED_SEND='N' AND trd.TRADE_STATUS='01' AND trd.IS_CANCEL='N' AND (trd.IS_CANCEL IS NOT NULL OR trd.IS_CANCEL='N')
AND (trd.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
null) OR trd.PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{item})
AND stl.SETTLE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{totleTradeId}),'%')
And trd.PS IN #{item2}
And trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IN (select TRADE_ID FROM STL_ACT_TRADE_MATCH)
And trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID NOT IN (select TRADE_ID FROM STL_ACT_TRADE_MATCH)

SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, NVL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TO_CHAR(t1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, TO_CHAR(t1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, T6.SETTLE_AMT, T6.PS , T6.PAY_TYPE as pay, decode(T1.ps,'C2',T7.ACCT_TYPE,T9.ACCT_TYPE) as acctType, T8.acct_no raiseAcctNo FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID and T1.ps='C2' and T7.acct_type='B15' LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T9 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T9.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T9.CCY AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T9.PORTFOLIO_ID and T1.ps in ('C4','C9','C5','C20','C17','C6') and T9.acct_type='B14' LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T8 on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID=T8.portfolio_id and T1.CCY=T8.CCY and T8.acct_type='B15' and T1.ps in ('C4','C9','C5','C20','C17','C6')
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IN
null) OR T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID in (
#{item}
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IN (select TRADE_ID FROM STL_ACT_TRADE_MATCH WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId})

SELECT T1.ACT_ORDER_ID orderId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.IS_NEED_SEND, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.PAY_TYPE, T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T3.BANK_DEP, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo, T2.BANK_DEP recBankDep, T2.IN_OUT_BANK, T1.PURPOSE, T1.REMARK, T6.HI_USER operatorUser, TO_CHAR(T6.CREATE_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') operatorTime, T7.HI_USER checkUser, TO_CHAR(T7.CREATE_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') checkTime FROM STL_ACT_ORDER T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 /*收款方*/ON ((T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 /*付款方*/ON ((T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T5 ON T1.ACT_ORDER_ID = T5.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T6 /*经办*/ON T5.SEQ_NO = T6.SEQ_NO AND T6.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_OPERATOR} LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T7 /*复核*/ON T5.SEQ_NO = T7.SEQ_NO AND T7.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_CHECKER} WHERE T1.ACT_ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT /*经办最大*/WHERE T5.SEQ_NO = TT.SEQ_NO AND TT.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_OPERATOR} AND TT.HIS_NO > T6.HIS_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT /*复核最大*/WHERE T5.SEQ_NO = TT.SEQ_NO AND TT.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_CHECKER} AND TT.HIS_NO > T7.HIS_NO)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM STL_ACT_TRADE_MATCH WHERE TRADE_ID IN ( null) OR TRADE_ID in (#{item.bizCode} )
SELECT stl.ORDER_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL trd LEFT JOIN STL_ACT_TRADE_MATCH stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{TOTLE_TRADE_ID}
